import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Filter the data to include only Hispanic men using .loc to avoid the warning
hispanic_men = df.loc[(df['GENDER'] == 'MALE') & (df['HISPANIC'] == 1)]

# Create a new variable for time preference, where 1 indicates a higher time preference (more savings)
hispanic_men['TIME_PREFERENCE'] = 1 - hispanic_men['DISSAVED'] - hispanic_men['SAMESAVE']

# Perform a linear regression analysis to determine the relationship between time preference and BMI
X = hispanic_men[['TIME_PREFERENCE']].values.reshape(-1, 1)
y = hispanic_men['BMI'].values

model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Calculate the p-value manually using the standard error of the coefficient
# This is a simplified approach and assumes normality of the residuals
from scipy.stats import t

# Calculate the standard error of the coefficient
n = len(X)
p = 1  # Number of predictors
se = np.sqrt(model.score(X, y) * (1 - model.score(X, y)) / (n - p - 1))

# Calculate the t-statistic
t_stat = model.coef_[0] / se

# Calculate the p-value
p_value = 2 * (1 - t.cdf(abs(t_stat), n - p - 1))

coefficient, p_value

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Filter the data to include only Hispanic men using .loc to avoid the warning
hispanic_men = df.loc[(df['GENDER'] == 'MALE') & (df['HISPANIC'] == 1)]

# Create a new variable for time preference, where 1 indicates a higher time preference (more savings)
hispanic_men['TIME_PREFERENCE'] = 1 - hispanic_men['DISSAVED'] - hispanic_men['SAMESAVE']

# Perform a linear regression analysis to determine the relationship between time preference and BMI
X = hispanic_men[['TIME_PREFERENCE']].values.reshape(-1, 1)
y = hispanic_men['BMI'].values

model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Calculate residuals
residuals = y - model.predict(X)

# Plot the residuals
sns.histplot(residuals, kde=True)
plt.title('Residuals Distribution')
plt.show()

# Check for homoscedasticity
sns.scatterplot(x=model.predict(X), y=residuals)
plt.title('Residuals vs Fitted Values')
plt.show()
